lines 14 to 27 and 29 to 36, imports of discord, random, asyncio, os, cpuinfo, github, pprint, bs4, logging, pytz, discord_slash, statcord etc.: not used by the snippet or replaced by the stub.

the other commands and events of the bot: outside the snippet.
scaffolding: Embed and the discord namespace: only what the snippet touches; stores title, color, thumbnail, fields (as tuples) and footer for the test to read.
SlashCommand and CommandObject: slash(...) returns an object with func and an asynchronous invoke, like the BaseCommandObject of the library; create_option returns the same dict as the library.
Context: author with name and avatar_url (discord.py 1.x) and an asynchronous send that stores the card sent.
run(location): creates the context, runs asyncio.run(weather.invoke(ctx, location)) and returns the cards sent.
The token is still read from ./tokens/weather.txt; the test creates the file in a temporary folder (monkeypatch.chdir).
Checked: Pysmell only flags lines 1155 and 1156 of the snippet; nothing in the scaffolding.
pinned_behavior: typical: URL requested with the city and the token; one card with title 'Weather in London, GB', color 0x3f3f3f, icon thumbnail, six fields in order (temperature in Celsius rounded, weather, wind, humidity, pressure, clouds) and a footer with the name and avatar of the requester.
edge: negative temperature (263.0 K becomes -10°C, rounded).
invalid: an error response from the API (without main) raises KeyError.
not_pinned_on_purpose: Name, description and options of the command in the decorator: they only serve to register the command on the chat server; the stub does not check them.
Token with a trailing line break: the original does not strip it (it would go into the URL); the test writes the token without a line break.
Rounding of .5 (Python's round rounds to even): not exercised.
